acceptance_criteria: AC203-1: Ground actual existing canonical GPU ownership/resource-broker mechanics and focused typed clients for existing and future modules. Record authoritative owner, allocation/client identities, dependencies, exact files and source-versus-host contracts before implementation. Reuse adequate capability; no invented mandatory framework, new monolith or assumption of one adapter/API.

AC203-2: All affected modules use centralized authoritative GPU device/queue/resource/pool/budget ownership through scoped typed clients. No per-module independent device/pool/budget bypass; unrelated CPU/NPU work stays in its owning contracts. Prove client/module attachment, detach and multiwindow ownership and denial/isolation conditions.

AC203-3: Bind accountable allocations/reservations/budgets, pressure/admission, staging and shared-versus-dedicated memory attribution to real authoritative resource state. Prove focused positive/negative pressure/budget behavior and truthful diagnostics without arbitrary new caps or fabricated memory success.

AC203-4: Bind submitted/in-flight work settlement, cancellation/retirement and reclamation. Prove resources are not freed before settlement, reclaimed twice or retained beyond owning lifecycle, using actual owned mechanisms and focused lifecycle/pressure checks. Preserve valid partial results and original process/resource protections.

AC203-5: Prove shutdown, device-loss/recovery, window resize/recreation and module attachment/detachment against actual owning typed contracts. Prevent stale clients or leaked ownership after recovery; unsupported cases remain explicit and cannot be hidden by renderer fallback.

AC203-6: Integrate the actual Vulkan GUI as a client of that owner with genuine backend/device/memory/lifecycle evidence on exact native inputs. D3D/OpenGL fallback is not Vulkan. Reusable canonical gaps need separate proven published source before host adoption; exact unchanged proof is reused. Current runtime/fetch/physical custody and scoped human retry authority remain, no automatic execution grant.

AC203-7: Actual allocation/pressure/staging/in-flight settlement/reclaim/shutdown/device-loss/recovery/window/module lifetime failures are observable through internal_diagnostics and correlated standalone Palmistry records with mechanical typed metadata/privacy. Reuse canonical watcher and allowlist; the broker/GUI does not become a copied watcher, recovery executor or OS remediation controller.
